titleEn: Royal decrees No. 0819/1303 on the establishment of Preah Sihanouk Appeal Court

articles.en: - The Preah Sihanouk Regional Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor’s Office attached to the Preah Sihanouk Regional Court of Appeal shall receive and decide appeals against the decisions of the First Instance Court of Takeo Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Kampot Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Kampong Speu Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Koh Kong Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, and the First Instance Court of Preah Sihanouk Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, or cases remitted by the Supreme Court.
- All provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

- The Supreme Council of the Magistracy and Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
[Illegible in source: seal and registration number]
Norodom Sihamoni; at the Royal Palace, 07 August 2019; certified true copy of the original; Minister in charge of the Council of Ministers, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Bin Chhin.
